page.overview:
What is Red Orb?

The Red Orb is a held item (Key item from Gen III-V) that controls Groudon in the Hoenn region.

In Ruby, Sapphire and Emerald, the Red Orb appears and controls Groudon in Ruby, which Archie attempts to use to control Kyogre, but fails in doing so.

In HeartGold and SoulSilver, it can also be obtained from Mr. Pokémon in both games and can be traded to its counterpart to receive the Jade Orb to awaken Rayquaza in the Embedded Tower.

In Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire, the Red Orb becomes a standard item to accommodate the Primal Reversion of Groudon. Category:Key items Category:Legendary Pokémon's Items Category:Orbs Category:Generation III Items Category:Generation VI Items Category:Form-changing Items Category:Items
